authority: implementation plan 7.2 item 7; experiment plan B0 metric-spec freeze

power_analysis.method: two-proportion z-test sample size: n per arm = (z_{alpha/2}+z_beta)^2 * (p1(1-p1)+p2(1-p2)) / (p1-p2)^2 with alpha=0.05 two-sided, power=0.8, (z_{alpha/2}+z_beta)^2 = 7.8489

rows.role: primary: large detectable arm effect on per-event operation success

power_analysis.consequence: the M1 census floors (prereg_m1_census_v1.json) adopt the primary row: 36 model-free opportunities per gated event class; the sensitivity rows are reported next to any near-floor census outcome
power_analysis.assumption_disclosure: events are treated as independent Bernoulli units within an arm; per-scene clustering will inflate variance - the B3 analysis uses the cluster bootstrap, so the floor is a lower bound on adequacy, reported as such

operation_level_metrics.return_timing_error: abs(committed return episode start - annotated/GT return time), frames; reported per opportunity stratum
operation_level_metrics.false_reactivation_rate: reactivations committed where no same-object return exists / committed reactivations
operation_level_metrics.false_birth_rate: births at return sites where the return family existed / return-site births
operation_level_metrics.identity_retention: fraction of annotated same-object returns realized as REACTIVATE or MERGE onto the original family (survivor-id semantics)

object_to_lineage_mapping.protocol: an annotated/GT object instance maps to the family whose primitives are nearest its triangulated centroid at each plateau, using the SAME preregistered binding threshold as cluster binding (elgs_binding_threshold); unmapped => reported unmatched, never silently dropped

classification_data_term_floors.definition: a data term is 'below floor' for the EQUIVALENCE-CLASS label iff its removal changes Delta_E_hat by less than 0.25 * SE of the decision

shift_shuffle_protocol.shifts: non-wrapping temporal shifts of the frozen track artifact by {+25, -25, +50, -50} frames; reports shifted outside the sequence are dropped and the effective factor mass reported
shift_shuffle_protocol.shuffles: track-identity shuffles within validity windows (same camera, same frame support)
shift_shuffle_protocol.dose_matching: each control lane consumes the same number of evidence factors as its aligned counterpart; the effective factor mass is reported per lane

rendering_metrics: PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS-Alex per the pinned N3V/DiVa protocol; dynamic-mask metrics via the existing MotionPriorCache path; no new photometric metrics invented (adopt, don't invent)
